{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patients:", data['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(data))

# Check how many duplicates there are
print("Number of duplicate patient_id entries:", len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check sample_seq to confirm deduplication logic
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
max_seq = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(max_seq.value_counts().sort_index())"}
